featureSections.headline: Built for People Who Take Meat Seriously
featureSections.body: Unlike traditional boards that rely on shallow juice grooves, the RAX Original Drip Board directs meat juices through the board and into a removable drip tray underneath — so steaks, brisket, turkey, and wild game stay on the board, not your counters.

featureSections.headline: Laser Precision & Custom Branding
featureSections.body: Every RAX board leaves with a laser-true edge and the steer mark burned into the grain. American hardwood — same drainage system, same RAX Cut Co. stamp.
featureSections.quote: If the grain isn't honest, we don't stamp it.

featureSections.headline: Slide Out. Wipe Clean. Done.
featureSections.body: When you're finished resting or carving, slide out the drip tray, empty it, and wash. No overflowing grooves. No soaked towels. No sticky counters.

items.title: Brisket juices stay in the tray
items.body: I sliced a 14-pound brisket and every drop went through the board into the drip tray. Counters stayed clean. This is the board I should've bought years ago.

items.name: Elena Voss
items.title: Steak night without the mess

items.name: Jonah Pratt
items.title: Built for wild game

items.name: Priya Nandakumar
items.title: Thanksgiving turkey, zero overflow

items.name: Cole Brennan
items.title: Smoker-side workhorse

items.name: Hannah Ruiz

items.body: Went with maple for the launch. Same drip system, heavy 2-inch build, still feels like a serious tool.

products.name: RAX Original Drip Board
products.description:
The RAX Original Drip Board is built for people who take meat seriously. Unlike traditional cutting boards that rely on shallow juice grooves, the RAX features an integrated drainage system that directs meat juices through the board and into a removable drip tray underneath.

Whether you're resting steaks, slicing brisket, carving a turkey, or processing wild game, RAX keeps the mess contained and your counters clean. When you're finished, simply slide out the drip tray for easy cleanup.
features: Designed for steaks, brisket, BBQ, wild game, and roasts
Helps prevent overflowing juice grooves and messy counters
